title: MouldIt: Data Efficiency of Multi-Task Temporal Representation Learning in Injection Moulding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart industrial solutions that can address multiple tasks require models that understand the underlying processes. We examine representation learning for modeling the injection moulding process as an example of such solutions. We consider its data efficiency and multi-modal benefit compared to classical machine learning alternatives. To this end, we synthesize a process-informed dataset based on a real reference cycle of an Erlanger Tr\"ager part. We then introduce MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention based variational autoencoder that reconstructs in-mould signals, while classifying parts as acceptable or as one of our synthetic failure modes. We evaluate MouldIt on two tasks, known-class classification and unknown-class detection, across nine dataset sizes in single-modal and multi-modal settings. translated_title: MouldIt：注塑成型中多任务时序表征学习的数据效率
translated_abstract: 能够处理多项任务的智能工业解决方案需要能够理解底层工艺过程的模型。我们以注塑成型过程的建模为例，研究此类解决方案中的表征学习。我们考察了其相对于经典机器学习替代方法的数据效率以及多模态带来的收益。为此，我们基于Erlanger Träger零件的真实参考生产周期合成了一个融合工艺信息的数据集。随后，我们提出了MouldIt——一种基于时序卷积和注意力机制的变分自编码器，它能够重构模内信号，同时将零件分类为合格品或我们合成的某一种失效模式。我们在已知类分类和未知类检测这两项任务上，跨越九种数据集规模，在单模态和多模态设置下对MouldIt进行了评估，并将其与“全部接受”基线以及经典方法（k近邻、逻辑回归、随机森林等）进行比较。
tldr: 本文提出MouldIt——一个基于时序卷积与注意力机制的变分自编码器，用于注塑成型过程的多任务时序表征学习，并系统评估了其在不同数据规模、单模态与多模态设置下相比经典机器学习方法的数据效率与多模态收益。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MouldIt, a temporal convolution and attention-based variational autoencoder for multi-task temporal representation learning in injection moulding, and systematically evaluates its data efficiency and multi-modal benefits compared to classical machine learning methods across various dataset sizes and modal settings.
